sources.snippet: Model Description OpenMed-PII-Italian-SuperClinical-Large-434M-v1 is a transformer-based token classification model fine-tuned for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection in Italian text. This model identifies and classifies 54 types of sensitive information including names, addresses, social security numbers, medical record numbers, and more.
